subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should a reconnected WebChat become the controlling client for the gateway's surviving active run, or display that run as detached activity with restricted controls?
rationale: Current main can recognize that the session remains active but intentionally clears local run ownership; abort, queue, event-replay, and multi-tab semantics cannot safely be inferred by an automated repair.

options.title: Adopt Surviving Run
options.body: Expose authoritative run identity and ownership so the reconnected UI restores normal transcript, busy, abort, and queue behavior.

options.title: Display Detached Activity
options.body: Show that the session remains active elsewhere, refresh durable history, and withhold run-specific controls until ownership is safely acquired.

recommendation.title: Adopt Surviving Run
recommendation.body: Expose authoritative run identity and ownership so the reconnected UI restores normal transcript, busy, abort, and queue behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent active-session tracking work is the closest merged ownership signal for deciding how server run state should be exposed to Control UI.
